description: Takes a B2B SaaS product onto Salesforce AppExchange (increasingly AgentExchange) as an ISV - partner entry, listing type, managed 2GP choices that can never be undone, security review prep and resubmission, PADA, Checkout, GTM app or Channel Order App pricing, LMA licensing, re-reviews, push upgrades, OAuth mandates. Use whenever a vendor mentions AppExchange, AgentExchange, the Salesforce security review, a managed package it distributes, the Salesforce ISV program or PNR revenue share. Vendor side only. Do NOT use for listing copy, search rank or reviews (use samber/developer-platform-skills@integration-listing-optimization), for reviewing apps on your own marketplace (use samber/developer-platform-skills@app-marketplace-review), or for Apex/LWC code, internal-org packages or consulting listings.
